tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_get_account_info
tools.description: Read current XRPL account state including balance, sequence, owner count, flags, and settings. Use for one account; not transaction history or ledger objects.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_transactions
tools.description: Read transaction history for one XRPL account over an optional ledger range. Use for multiple transactions, not a single transaction lookup.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_get_transaction
tools.description: Retrieve one XRPL transaction by hash. Use when the transaction hash is known; not for account-wide history.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger
tools.description: Read XRPL ledger header and optional transaction listing. Use for ledger metadata; not raw ledger-state objects.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data
tools.description: Read raw XRPL ledger-state objects and paginate with marker. Use for ledger entries; not ledger header metadata.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_get_book_offers
tools.description: Read the XRPL DEX order book for a specific trading pair. Use for offers and market depth; not account-owned offers.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_find_path
tools.description: Find XRPL payment paths from a source account to a destination amount. Use for path discovery; not DEX order-book retrieval.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_lines
tools.description: List XRPL trust lines for an account, including issued-asset balances and limits. Use to inspect trust-line state before or after TrustSet.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_objects
tools.description: Inspect raw/canonical XRPL ledger objects associated with an account. Use this low-level view for ledger object types that do not have a dedicated N9T2 lister, or when canonical ledger-entry fields are required. For account-level NFT offers, set object_type to nft_offer to filter NFTokenOffer ledger

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_offers
tools.description: List outstanding XRPL DEX offers owned by one account. Use to inspect the account's own open offers; not the global order book.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_channels
tools.description: List XRPL Payment Channels owned by the account. By default, returns channels where the account is the source. Use destination_account to filter to channels whose destination is a specific account. Use to inspect channels before or after PaymentChannelCreate/Fund/Claim.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_get_server_info
tools.description: Read XRPL server health and validated-ledger information. Use to inspect node state and current ledger validation status.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_get_gateway_balances
tools.description: Calculate issued-asset balances for an XRPL issuing account. Use to inspect issued IOU exposure and operational hot-wallet balances.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_nfts
tools.description: List NFTs owned by an XRPL classic account using the native account_nfts method. Use this instead of list_account_objects when you need NFT-specific fields such as NFTokenID, Issuer, NFTokenTaxon, URI, and nft_serial. This is read-only and does not modify the ledger. Use ledger_hash or ledger_index

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_subscribe
tools.description: Open a bounded XRPL WebSocket subscription and capture live events for the requested streams, accounts, proposed transactions, or order books. Use this when an agent needs event-driven updates instead of a one-time snapshot. The tool sends the native XRPL subscribe command, collects events for durat

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_submit_transaction
tools.description: Submit an already-signed XRPL transaction blob. N9T2 never signs transactions or receives private keys.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_prepare_transaction
tools.description: Prepare one unsigned XRPL transaction for agent-local signing. Choose exactly one transaction_type and provide its typed XRPL parameters in parameters. N9T2 routes established transaction types to their existing validators/builders and supports additional XRPL models including Clawback, DID, OracleS

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_get_amm_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed XRPL Automated Market Maker (AMM) state for a specified AMM account or asset pair. Returns native amm_info data including pool balances, LP token supply, trading fee, auction slot, and vote slots when present. This is read-only and does not modify the ledger.

tools.name: n9t2_xrpl_list_nft_offers
tools.description: Retrieve XRPL NFT marketplace offers for a specific NFToken. Use offer_type=buy for native nft_buy_offers, sell for native nft_sell_offers, or both to retrieve both sides in one paid call. Supports ledger pinning and independent pagination markers.
